title: MapTeleport Component Schema
description: All MapTeleport custom action parameter definitions. Referenced by custom.action.schema.json.

MapTeleportSelectParam.description: Parameters for MapTeleportSelect: find the given teleport point on the open world map and click it.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Zone name, i.e. the directory name under assets/resource/image/MapLocator/.

target.title: Target
target.description: Teleport point [x, y] in that zone's base map pixel frame.

max_attempts.title: Max Attempts
max_attempts.description: Recognition attempts. Panning the map is not charged against it. Optional, defaults to 4.

gate_base.title: Gate Base
gate_base.description: Maximum offset between the match and the expected position, in base map pixels. Ignored when radius is set. Optional, defaults to 10.0.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Icon template file names under assets/resource/image/SceneManager/. The highest scoring one wins, which covers a point drawn in more than one style. Optional, defaults to the ordinary teleport point template.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Search the icon within this radius of the target, in base map pixels, for a point whose icon is not pinned to a fixed spot. Zero searches a small fixed window instead. Optional, defaults to 0.

scale_max.title: Scale Max
scale_max.description: Upper bound of the icon template scale sweep. Retune it together with the template: one shipped at a different size lands on a different scale. Zero keeps the built-in bound. Optional, defaults to 0.

min_score.title: Min Score
min_score.description: Match score floor. Retune it per template: a larger one scores higher on plain map texture, so the floor has to clear its background peak. Zero keeps the built-in floor. Optional, defaults to 0.

min_gold_ratio.title: Min Gold Ratio
min_gold_ratio.description: Fraction of the template's gold pixels that must still read as saturated for the point to count as unlocked. Needs a template calibrated against locked captures. Zero skips the check. Optional, defaults to 0.
